description: Render one preview across the cross-product of the given override axes in a single call, returning a hash/size observation per cell (observe=png adds the pixels). Prefer this over a catalog_render_preview per combination: the cells share one catalog lease and are reported together, so comparing axes costs one round trip instead of N. Capped at 24 cells. Requires live grant scope.

token.description: A grant token from poll_access, when you cannot set the X-Compose-Preview-Token header yourself — an MCP client fixes its headers at connect time, so this is how a token approved during this session is used in it. Prefer the header where you control it.

name: catalog_render_matrix
